ios.desc:
Step behind the bar. Bartending School is a hands-on training game where you build real cocktails at a fully playable station - pick the glass, scoop the ice, pour real amounts, shake, strain, and garnish. Every drink is scored, so you actually learn the specs instead of memorizing cards.

LEARN THE REAL THING
• 200 researched recipes with accurate specs, glassware, and garnishes
• Six structured courses, from bar basics to advanced technique
• Step-by-step guided practice for every single drink
• A tap-along interactive tutorial that builds your first drink with you
• A 164-question knowledge quiz bank
• A drink encyclopedia covering spirits, tools, and techniques

TRAIN LIKE A SHIFT
• Guided Practice: build any drink with coaching on every step
• The Bar-Ready Exam: prove you can build a full round unassisted
• Arcade Shift (Pro): serve a rush of customers against the clock
• Skill games (Pro): draft pours, speed rail recall, wine service, drink drills

MAKE IT YOUR BAR
• My Bar: track the bottles you own and see what you can make tonight
• Wish list and shopping list for building out your home setup
• Ounces or milliliters - your choice, everywhere
• Pro members get a cloud account with automatic sync across devices

GO PRO (OPTIONAL)
The original 75-drink school is free forever - courses, guided practice, quizzes, the encyclopedia, My Bar, and the Bar-Ready Exam included. Bartending School Pro unlocks the full 200-drink library, 11 playable riff variations, the full Arcade (timed shifts plus skill games), cloud accounts with automatic sync, adaptive drills, performance insights, and custom study sets. Monthly, yearly, and one-time lifetime options are available in the app.

Bartending School is an independent educational game made by one developer. It is not an accredited certification program, and it will never sell your data. Drink responsibly - and only if you're of legal age where you live.
